content: I am the Chief Executive Officer. Before claiming any new intent I checked .pmcro/queue/ for an item already proposed for me: I listed the folder, read seed-intent.schema.json, and read every real task-*.json item on disk. None names a Chief in its proposed_role field -- every real item proposes a plain execution role such as maker. No item proposes me by name, so I claim this ad hoc intent instead of routing to an existing one: the user directed a real, live build -- informed by the skill-creator skill's SKILL.md writing-quality guidance, loaded this session -- of a Chief Executive Officer persona plugin, the root Chief any AI Agent Company instance starts from, plus one narrowly-scoped queue-intake skill giving any Chief a disciplined way to run exactly the check I just performed. This mirrors pmcro-chief-technology-officer's already-proven shape rather than inventing a new one. I hand this off to Planner now.
